descriptions.value: Server-side request forgery (ssrf) in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to perform spoofing over an adjacent network.
In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3 kotlin scripts could trigger dependency downloads from arbitrary repositories in untrusted projects

In send_vdu_directive of gdmc/gsp/dev/bmsm/plat/lga/vdu.c, there is a possible Logic error due to a logic error in the code. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with execution privileges needed. User interaction is for exploitation.
